# Descanto docs (docs.descanto.com)

> Developer documentation for Descanto, the instant-wake cloud desktop platform for computer-use agents. The canonical agent guide (when to use Descanto, API surface, SDKs, CLI, MCP) lives at https://descanto.com/llms.txt.

## Key pages

- [Developer portal](https://docs.descanto.com/developers): API keys, all docs and tools, sandbox options
- [What is Descanto](https://docs.descanto.com/): the hibernation model and architecture
- [Quickstart](https://docs.descanto.com/quickstart): first desktop in five minutes
- [API overview](https://docs.descanto.com/api/overview): auth, versioning, errors, pagination
- [Desktops API](https://docs.descanto.com/api/desktops): create, wake, hibernate, fork, destroy
- [Exec and files](https://docs.descanto.com/api/exec-and-files): run commands, read/write files
- [Computer use](https://docs.descanto.com/api/computer-use): screenshot, input, display
- [Ports](https://docs.descanto.com/api/ports): public URLs for guest TCP ports
- [Webhooks](https://docs.descanto.com/api/webhooks): HMAC-signed lifecycle events
- [TypeScript SDK](https://docs.descanto.com/sdk/typescript) · [Python SDK](https://docs.descanto.com/sdk/python)
- [CLI](https://docs.descanto.com/cli): the `canto` command (`npm i -g @descanto/vm-cli`)
- [MCP server](https://docs.descanto.com/mcp): `npx -y @descanto/vm-mcp`

## Machine-readable

- OpenAPI spec: https://descanto.com/openapi.json (also at https://api.descanto.com/v1/openapi.json)
- Docs sitemap: https://docs.descanto.com/sitemap.xml
- Site sitemap: https://descanto.com/sitemap.xml
